game.js is upstream dist/1-build/index.js (the Vite classic bundle,
DEBUG compiled out, shaders and the ground SVG already inlined). A GIF
srcdoc cannot fetch and cannot reload, so three patches land here:
  - NO_INLINE is defined (the 1-build still calls it)
  - Restart clears the save and drops the player; no location.reload
  - loadGame waits for DanteSave.ready so gifos.db can hydrate first
  - After the colour pass, DanteEngine.drawGhosts may paint extra bodies
  - window.DanteEngine exposes player pose, meshes, and save/load
Both notices travel INSIDE the GIF as well as beside it here.
